title: Correct the destination walk measure and bind each start and experiment to its checkpoint
summary: The walk measure now starts the destination where training does, at the reset pose, so destination_v9 ends 0.57 mm (median) and 0.94 mm (worst) from where the command leads, not 1.3 and 1.8 mm; on this measure destination_v8 ends closer (0.39 and 0.84 mm) but fails one stop probe. Starting from a checkpoint keeps an empirical normalizer's scale for the added inputs, checks the starting checkpoint's declaration and robot, and records them; evaluation refuses a checkpoint of another experiment, and an experiment checkpoint records its own reward version.
next: Read the destination_v9 96-case manifest run when it finishes and decide on acceptance from it.
reason: The fixes correct a reported measure and the records that bind checkpoints; no trained network, reward or threshold changes, and the roadmap stays at Stage 2.
